title: Patrick AFB helicopter flies out to the light

tellings.quote:
we see one of the
helicopters from the Air Force base go
out to it.

plain: In 2013, off Cocoa Beach in Florida, a helicopter from nearby Patrick Air Force Base flew out toward a strange light over the water. Charles Buhler, who has worked at NASA, tells Michels he watched it happen: 'we see one of the helicopters from the Air Force base go out to it.' If that is what happened, the military was taking an interest in the light too.
